notes: CBS code 120010 = 'Consumer Price Index - General' from the dedicated apis.cbs.gov.il/index/data/price API (distinct from the general series/* API, whose catalog is unreliable — see CLAUDE.md). Both sides report a year-over-year inflation rate (CBS percentYear vs Eurostat RCH_A_AVG), so the two are genuinely comparable despite different index base years.
CBS code 40010 = 'Prices of Dwellings' from the same dedicated price-index API. Both sides use annual rate of change, so directly comparable across different index base years.
